Estimate FAQ

Is the estimate really free?

Yes. Always. No strings attached.

Do I have to be home?

Usually yes for the walkthrough, so we can talk through what we find — we'll confirm details when we schedule.

How long does it take to get an estimate?

We'll give you a specific window when we schedule the visit — it depends on our current schedule and your location.
